name: WXSUMM weather summary (Beam)
description: Decodes fixed-length EBCDIC weather observations (copybook WXOBS), validates them with the legacy rules, and writes daily station summaries to BigQuery, rejects to BigQuery and Pub/Sub, and legacy-format text files to Cloud Storage.

parameters.name: input
parameters.label: Input file pattern
parameters.helpText: Cloud Storage path of the EBCDIC input, e.g. gs://bucket/obs/sample/obs.ebc

parameters.name: output
parameters.label: Output directory
parameters.helpText: Cloud Storage directory for summary.txt, errors.txt and split_keys.txt

parameters.name: bqSummaryTable
parameters.label: BigQuery summary table
parameters.helpText: PROJECT:DATASET.TABLE; the table must already exist

parameters.name: bqErrorsTable
parameters.label: BigQuery errors table
parameters.helpText: PROJECT:DATASET.TABLE; the table must already exist

parameters.name: deadLetterTopic
parameters.label: Pub/Sub dead-letter topic
parameters.helpText: projects/PROJECT/topics/TOPIC; one JSON message per rejected record

parameters.name: runId
parameters.label: Run ID
parameters.helpText: Written to every BigQuery row; defaults to run-<UTC timestamp>
